asset.name: Room booking confirmed
asset.description: Sent to the organiser when a booking is confirmed (automatically or by facilities).
asset.subject: Confirmed: {{room}} on {{booking_date}} at {{start_time}}
asset.html_body:
{{room}} is booked

Your booking for {{meeting_title}} is confirmed.

Room{{room}} (floor {{room_row.floor}}, {{room_row.capacity}} seats)
When{{=FORMAT_DATE(booking_date, "DD/MM/YYYY")}} at {{start_time}} for {{duration_hours}} h
Attendees{{attendees}}
Reference{{booking_ref}}

Equipment in the room: {{room_row.equipment}}.

{{=IF(IS_EMPTY(facilities_note), "", CONCAT("Note from facilities: ", facilities_note))}}

Sent by the meeting room booking workflow
asset.text_body: Confirmed: {{room}} on {{booking_date}} at {{start_time}} for {{duration_hours}} h ({{meeting_title}}). Reference {{booking_ref}}.
